verdict.rationale: GitCafe's docs index says issues can be tracked with 'labels and milestones', so grouping issues into milestones is a first-party capability. That is the only mention, and nothing shows milestones carrying due dates. Missing for 10: evidence that milestones support due dates, in-depth milestone documentation (creating milestones, assigning issues, progress tracking), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
